section.title: Specialization hierarchy
section.p: The dvrResourcePrefix element is specialized from data. It is defined in the DITAVAL-reference domain module.

section.title: Attributes
section.p: The following attributes are available on this element: (except for conkeyref, which is removed for all elements in this domain) and name.
For this element, the name attribute has a default value of dvrResourcePrefix.

example.title: Example
example.draft-comment:
This comment applies to all four metadata elements in the ditavalmeta element.
Should these examples move into the architectural specification with other branch filter examples? These are not about the general filtering behavior, and each example is specific to the element described. Examples in the architectural specification all focus on filtering. However, these are clearly about processing impact, so might be better to group them with all of the other branch filtering examples in that section, and turn the example sections here into a reference - "See [branch filtering examples]".
If they do move, we would end up with 5 new example topics – one each for the impact on resource prefix/sufix + keyscope prefix/suffix, and another for the impact on resource IDs.

fig.title: How dvrResourcePrefix affects resource file names
fig.p: The following code sample shows a simple branch with a parent and child topic, where the branch uses a ditavalref element and dvrResourcePrefix.<topicref href="branch-01.dita"> <ditavalref href="condition-01.ditaval"> <ditavalmeta> <dvrResourcePrefix>cond01-</dvrResourcePrefix> </ditavalmeta> </ditavalref> <topicref href="topics/subtopic-01.dita"/> </topicref>

After the ditavalref is evaluated:
The effective file name of the resource subtopic-01.dita is cond01-subtopic-01.dita.
The effective file name of resource branch-01.dita is cond01-branch-01.dita.

fig.title: How dvrResourcePrefix interacts with resourceid
fig.p: The following code sample shows the same branch with a parent and child topic, but in this case the child topic specifies a deliverable anchor with resourceid.<topicref href="branch-01.dita"> <ditavalref href="condition-01.ditaval"> <ditavalmeta> <dvrResourcePrefix>cond01-</dvrResourcePrefix> </ditavalmeta> </ditavalref> <topicref href="topics/subtopic-01.dita"> <topicmeta> <resourceid appid="ae35-unit-fault" appid-role="deliverable-anchor"/> </topicmeta> </topicref> </topicref>

After the ditavalref is evaluated:
The effective file name of the resource subtopic-01.dita is cond01-subtopic-01.dita.
The effective file name of resource branch-01.dita is cond01-branch-01.dita.
The effective value of appid on resourceid for the child topic is cond01-ae35-unit-fault.
